title: Classifier-Guided Latent Diffusion for Small-Molecule Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a promising class of generative models for molecular design because of their ability to learn complex chemical distributions and support conditional or guided generation. In this work, we investigate a latent diffusion pipeline for property-guided small-molecule generation. The proposed framework represents canonicalized SMILES strings using a frozen ChemBERTa encoder, trains a Transformer-based decoder to reconstruct SELFIES strings from molecular latent embeddings, and learns an unconditional denoising diffusion model in the ChemBERTa latent space. To enable property-directed generation, a differentiable latent property predictor is used to guide the diffusion sampling process. Generated SELFIES strings are converted to SMILES, validated using RDKit, and evaluated using molecular validity, uniqueness, novelty, and predicted property scores. translated_title: 面向小分子生成的分类器引导潜在扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型因其能够学习复杂的化学分布并支持条件生成或引导生成，已成为分子设计领域一类有前景的生成模型。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种用于性质引导小分子生成的潜在扩散流程。所提出的框架使用冻结的ChemBERTa编码器来表示规范化的SMILES字符串，训练基于Transformer的解码器从分子潜在嵌入中重构SELFIES字符串，并在ChemBERTa潜在空间中学习一个无条件的去噪扩散模型。为实现性质导向的生成，使用可微分的潜在性质预测器来引导扩散采样过程。生成的SELFIES字符串被转换为SMILES，使用RDKit进行验证，并通过分子有效性、唯一性、新颖性和预测性质分数进行评估。我们研究了针对两个药物相关二元终点的引导（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出在ChemBERTa潜在空间中构建去噪扩散模型，并利用可微分的性质预测器引导扩散采样过程，实现性质导向的小分子生成，生成的分子通过有效性、唯一性、新颖性和性质分数进行评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unconditional denoising diffusion model in the ChemBERTa latent space, guided by a differentiable latent property predictor during sampling, to enable property-directed small-molecule generation evaluated by validity, uniqueness, novelty, and predicted property scores.
